variants.name: 중장갑 가디언
variants.detail: Proposal number "01". Subject: a stout BIPEDAL heavy stone guardian, an armored cousin of reference 1. One huge squat head sunk between massive rounded slab pauldrons, simple stern eyes, very thick wraparound weathered ochre-brass brow helmet and shoulder armor, warm gray stone body. Wide low barrel torso, short stone legs and very broad flat feet, compact fists; forearm plating reads as built-in thick protective vambraces rather than carried shields. Broad gold shoulders and helmet create a distinct tank silhouette. One small recessed teal angular rune on top helmet and a small amber chest core. Head roughly 35 percent total height, shoulders wider than head. Strong silhouette and chunky friendly severity.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: RuneNexus tank enemy DESIGN PROPOSAL only, high-quality polished stylized 3D character concept image.
Input images: reference 1 is the game's current ordinary stone guardian, reference 2 the current fast stone rune hound, reference 3 the earlier enemy library whose gold/brass shell at upper middle is the existing tank. Use them as the SAME GAME'S visual family reference; create a new tank design, do not copy the other enemies or the whole enemy grid.
Game art direction: chunky sculpted stone volumes, big readable planes with chamfered edges, believable granular weathered stone and restrained ancient brass metal fixtures, recessed simple geometric rune inscriptions, a little contained magical glow. Fantasy rune constructs, charming stern demeanor, compact toy-like proportions, real depth and contacts, no photoreal gore. Retain warm muted brass/gold armor as the tank's role accent, with subtle turquoise/teal rune energy tying into game theme.
Every proposal must clearly read as a slow durable TANK via broad footprint, heavy protection, low center of gravity and short weight-bearing limbs. More robust than the ordinary reference, less speedy than the hound. Playable normal enemy proportions, not a giant boss.
Composition: square clean concept plate on a plain dark desaturated navy-gray studio ground, one large full-body three-quarter view angled toward the lower-left, well-lit visible front/side/top armor, entirely uncropped, occupies about 78 percent of canvas. Add ONE small separate high-angle near-top-down orthographic inset of THE EXACT SAME character in the upper-right, matching every body part and material, to check silhouette for the game's aerial camera. Main character remains dominant. Keep floor unobtrusive with grounding shadow, no pedestal. Clear broad material separation, soft studio key and restrained fill. No cinematic background, scene, weapons, UI, health bars, smoke, glowing aura, excessive spines, micro ornaments, cables, futuristic robotics, floating parts, logos or watermark. Only a tiny simple proposal number in upper-left; no other text.

variants.name: 룬 거북
variants.detail: Proposal number "02". Subject: a broad low QUADRUPED ancient rune TORTOISE construct. Large domed segmented warm gray stone shell made of 5 to 7 thick broad interlocking slabs, encircled by an aged ochre-brass protective rim and a single broad central brass dorsal reinforcement band. Four SHORT stocky stone legs, massive flat block feet, small stern carved turtle head partially tucked under front shell, teal inset eyes. Neck is short and heavily sheltered. One large readable geometric teal rune recessed into the top central shell slab, faint local glow only. No spikes, guns, towers, vegetation or straps. Silhouette has a clearly domed wide shell and very low center of gravity, calm stubborn slow tank; visibly distinct from a hound and a humanoid.

variants.name: 성벽 골렘
variants.detail: Proposal number "03". Subject: a BIPEDAL WALKING RAMPART golem with a broad squared upper torso built from three thick offset interlocking weathered warm-gray stone wall slabs; NOT a human in armor. Tiny head with a narrow inset teal eye slit sheltered beneath the torso's top stone lintel, almost integrated into chest. A wide flat upper slab with a small simple recessed teal rune and two heavy brass corner clamps, no turrets/crenellations/castle miniatures. Huge vertically oriented rectangular stone forearms shield the sides, wrists have minimal dark joint gaps. Two short squat feet, body very wide and squat, forward torso forms a solid thick barricade. Aged ochre-brass edges and small brackets only, broad planar stone dominates. Visually feels like an ancient fortress wall that learned to walk. Not a robot, not a knight, no carried shield or weapon.

variants.name: 장갑 야수
variants.detail: Proposal number "04". Subject: a stocky QUADRUPED stone armored beast with rhinoceros/armadillo strength, ancient rune construct in the same family as the hound reference but MUCH broader, shorter-legged and heavier. Large low blunt rhino-like wedge head, one short blunt stone nose horn capped in aged ochre brass, no tall horns or antlers, recessed teal eyes. Barrel-shaped warm slate-gray stone body encased in 3 thick overlapping broad ochre-brass back and shoulder armor bands; gaps reveal dark stone. Four very short pillar-like stone legs and broad blunt feet, a tiny stone tail. One simple contained teal geometric rune inset in central dorsal armor. Thick front shoulder plates, low neck, dense bulldozer stance. No elongated dog ears, claws or teeth, no saddle, mounted cannon, riders, or steampunk gears. More warm brass protection than the hound, maximal silhouette differentiation.
